title: Hebbian Robotics Targets the Data Pipeline Bottleneck in Robot Training
dek: HFlow is an open-source SDK for turning synchronized robot recordings into standardized, quality-checked, reproducible datasets.
socialCaption: Hebbian Robotics has launched HFlow, an open-source SDK for quality-checking, transforming and tracking multimodal robotics recordings. The target is a growing bottleneck: turning raw robot data into reproducible training datasets.
